card.line: Perez-uzzah is the place David named after God struck down Uzzah beside the ark of God. Its name means the LORD burst forth against Uzzah.

moments.title: Uzzah dies by the ark
moments.text: God's anger burned against Uzzah for his irreverence, and He struck him down beside the ark of God. Uzzah died there.

moments.title: David names the place
moments.text: David became angry that the LORD had burst forth against Uzzah, so he named the place Perez-uzzah. It is still called that to this day.

moments.title: David fears and turns aside
moments.text: David feared the LORD and asked how the ark could ever come to him. He would not move it to the City of David, but took it to the house of Obed-edom.
